Leuten verschaukeln lassen, die hier
nicht wohnen! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Keine Zeit für so was!{{TAG:000F:0005:00000000}}

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Şekerim,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} bu kasabanın gerçek

Peki, bay bay!

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}It's pronounced "aw revwah,"

busy lady at the moment.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}No tienes clase ni para despedirte.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Venga, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}aire, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}que soy una jirafa
muy ocupada.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Tu connais l'expression « du
balai » ?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Non ? Eh bien va donc

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}La parola giusta è "goodbye",

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}'Au revoir' diye okunur,

{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Oh, suddenly you ARE from this

for your little white lie?
No matter!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} If you really are a town
resident, perhaps I could use you.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Oh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿de repente sí que eres de
este pueblo? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿De verdad te has
creído que me has tomado el pelo?
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Lo que tiene que aguantar una{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}En fin, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}si eres de aquí, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}seguro que

{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Oh, donc maintenant tu habites dans

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Je déteste les menteurs...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Mais peu

m'être utile.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Oh, all'improvviso tu sei di questa
città?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} E pretendi che io ti creda?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Beh, non importa!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Se mi assicuri
che vivi qui, forse posso chiederti
di prendere parte alla mia ricerca.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Ach, auf einmal kommst du doch
von hier? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Dachtest du, man könnte
so der Modepolizei entgehen, ja?
Nun ja... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenn du hier wohnst,
könntest du mir doch noch nützlich
sein...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Aa, birden bu kasabadan mı
oldun?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Bu küçük beyaz yalana
kanacağımı mı sandın? Neyse!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
Gerçekten burada yaşıyorsan
belki işime yararsın.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Do you need something else? I
really don't have time for someone
who doesn't care for fashion...{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:00000000}}
Maybe I do care...
OK, see ya!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mais alors, pourquoi es-tu là ?! 
Comment peut-on être aussi
insensible aux charmes de la mode ?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:00000000}}
En fait, j'aime bien !
Bah, c'est comme ça...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}So bringst du mir überhaupt nichts!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ich komm nicht darüber hinweg, wie
man so gar kein Interesse an Mode
haben kann...{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:00000000}}
Vielleicht ja doch...
Okay, ciao!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Başka bir şey mi istiyorsun?
Modayı umursamayan biri için
gerçekten vaktim yok...{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0005:00000000}}
Belki önemsiyorum...
Peki, görüşürüz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}"See ya," indeed. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Time for us to
part ways. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}We're worlds apart when
it comes to the important things.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}"Hasta otra", {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}exacto. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Será mejor
que me centre en las cosas que
importan y no pierda más el tiempo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Oui c'est ça, au revoir. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Nous
n'avons apparemment pas les
mêmes centres d'intérêt...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Eh sì, "ciao" è la parola giusta.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}È ora di salutarsi, tesoro.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Viviamo in due mondi diversi!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}„Ciao“?!? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Pah! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du wirst MIR
und meinem Modeimperium noch
bitterlich nachweinen...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}'Görüşürüz' öyle mi.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} O zaman
yollarımız ayrılsın.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Önemli
konularda bambaşka dünyalardayız.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}You're not stringing me along,
are you? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Fine, I'll take you at
your word.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}You'll be representing your town
in this Fashion Evaluation,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} so put
your best foot forward, darling!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}No lo dirás solo para seguirme
la corriente, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿no? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Bueno, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}haré
como que me creo lo que dices.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Vas a representar a tu pueblo
en esta evaluación de moda!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ponle un poco de empeño, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}encanto.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Non stai cercando di truffarmi,
vero? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Va bene, allora ti credo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Nel fashion check di oggi,
tu rappresenti tutta la tua città...
{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Quindi, tesoro, impegnati!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Etwas kapriziös, {{TAG:000E:0006:100064006500720020004700750074006500100064006900650020004700750074006500}}, hm?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Heute hü, morgen hott... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Also
gut, ich nehme dich beim Wort.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Und mach der Stadt ja keine
Schande bei diesem Outfit-
Check, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}hörst du?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Beni oyalamıyorsun, değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Pekâlâ, sözüne inanacağım.{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Bu
Moda Değerlendirmesinde kasabanı
temsil edeceksin,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} elinden
gelenin en iyisini göster, şekerim!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Cuánto tiempo! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Anda, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}dime que
has pulido tus conocimientos sobre
moda desde la última vez, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}encanto.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ça fait un bail !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} As-tu aiguisé ton
sens de la mode depuis notre
dernière rencontre ?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Gute Güte, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}schon so lange her!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Hast du in der Zwischenzeit fleißig
Modeinspirationen gesammelt?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Uzun zaman oldu!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Son
görüşmemizden beri moda
anlayışını biraz geliştirdin mi, şekerim?

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Pero cuánto tiempo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}cariño!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Espero que tu sentido de la moda
siga igual de fino.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ça fait un bail ! J'espère que tu as
eu le temps d'affûter tes goûts
vestimentaires.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Quanto tempo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Spero che ti sia
dedicat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} al miglioramento del tuo
stile, ultimamente!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Lang nicht mehr gesehen...
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Hoffentlich hast du deinen Sinn für
Mode in der ganzen Zeit behalten!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Çok uzun zaman geçti!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Umarım bu
sürede stil anlayışını parlatmışsındır.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I need to make sure this town is
fashion forward enough to warrant
my opening a store here!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}I can't let the GracieGrace brand
appear just anywhere, you know.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} It
would reflect poorly on me if I did!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}On that note, I need you to assist
me in a little Fashion Evaluation.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
I hope you're up for the challenge!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡No sé si este lugar tiene suficiente
buen gusto como para que me
compense abrir una boutique!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}La divina Graciela no puede estar
en cualquier sitio, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿me entiendes?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Tengo que cuidar mi marca!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Por lo tanto, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}me vendría bien tu
ayuda para una evaluación de moda.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿Qué? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿Aceptas el reto?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Je dois être sûre que cette ville est
suffisamment branchée avant d'y
ouvrir une boutique.
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Je ne voudrais pas galvauder mes
créations en ouvrant des boutiques
à tort et à travers.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tiens, d'ailleurs, j'aimerais te
soumettre à un défi vestimentaire.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
J'espère que tu seras à la hauteur !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Devo assicurarmi che questa città
sia sufficientemente stilosa
da ospitare una mia boutique!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Non posso lasciare che il marchio
Griffe di Griffa si annacqui in posti
che non lo meritano.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Mai e poi mai!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A proposito, ho bisogno del tuo
aiuto per valutare il look locale.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Spero che vorrai darmi una mano!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ich muss sichergehen, dass diese
Stadt meine Mode wertschätzt,
bevor hier ein Laden entsteht!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Die Marke „Grazias Grazie“ kann
ja nicht überall wahllos aus dem
Boden sprießen. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Exklusivität zählt!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Und deshalb brauche ich dich für
einen kleinen, feinen Outfit-Check.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du magst doch Herausforderungen?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Burada dükkân açmaya değecek
kadar moda bilinci var mı emin
olmalıyım!{{TAG:0003:0028:}} GracieGrace markasını
öyle her yerde gösteremem.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
İtibarımı zedeler!{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Bu yüzden
küçük bir Moda
Değerlendirmesinde bana yardım
edeceksin.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Umarım meydan okumaya hazırsın!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ready for your fashion check,

Ready!
What was the theme?
Not yet...
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿List{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} para tu evaluación de moda?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
¡Vamos allá!

Aún no...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Alors, tu penses être prêt{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}},
darling ?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
Oui !
Quel était le thème ?
Pas encore...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Sei pront{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} per il tuo fashion check,
tesoro?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
Certo!
Qual era il tema?
No, non ancora...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Bereit für deinen Outfit-Check?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
Bereit!
Wie war das Thema?
Noch nicht...

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Moda kontrolüne hazır mısın,
şekerim?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
Hazırım!
Tema neydi?
Henüz değil...

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Then SHOO!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} I'm a very busy lady,
so please stop wasting my time.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Pues a correr! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Que soy una jirafa
muy ocupada, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}no me hagas perder
el tiempo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Alors DU BALAI !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Je suis trop
occupée pour me permettre de
papoter avec toi.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Allora...{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} SCIÒ!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Sono una donna

perdere tempo!

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Dann HUSCH, HUSCH! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich bin eine

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}O zaman UÇ!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Çok meşgulüm; lütfen

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tu m'as l'air bien sûr{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} de toi !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} OK,

devant moi.

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Na, du klingst ja sehr überzeugt von

ein Minütchen Zeit. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Legen wir los.

ES:
Oh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}eres tú.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} ¿Qué quieres?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
¡Venganza!
¿Cuál era el tema?

FR:
Oh, c'est encore toi.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Qu'est-ce qui
t'amène ?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
Je veux ma revanche !
Quel est le thème ?
Rien...
IT:
Oh, sei di nuovo tu.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Cosa vuoi?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
La rivincita!
Qual è il tema?

DE:
Ach, du bist's!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Was gibt's denn?{{TAG:000D:0008:02CD}}{{TAG:000F:0006:000000000000}}
Revanche!

Och, nichts...

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¿Entonces para qué me molestas?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Mira, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}encanto, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}estoy hasta arriba

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Pourquoi tu viens me déranger, si

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Und warum hältst du mich dann auf?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Schätzchen, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}ich bin sehr beschäftigt
heute, also lass bitte den Unsinn!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}O zaman beni niye rahatsız

boğazıma kadar işim var,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
lüt-feeen önümden çekil!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}You forgot the theme I gave you?
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}How unprofessional of you!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}But at least you're trying, so I'll
give you points for that.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Try to
listen more closely this time.
Your theme is...

{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Tu as oublié le thème que je t'ai
donné ? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Quel manque de
professionnalisme !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bon, c'est pas si grave, au moins tu
fais l'effort d'essayer.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Alors écoute
bien cette fois : le thème est...

{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Hai dimenticato il tema che ti avevo
assegnato? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Non ti facevo così
poco professionale!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Comunque, ti stai impegnando,
lo ammetto.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Te lo ridico, ma non
dimenticarlo più! Il tuo tema è...

{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Du hast das Thema vergessen, das
ich dir aufgetragen habe? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wie
überaus unprofessionell von dir!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Gut, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}immerhin bist du bemüht, das
rechne ich dir an.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hör mir diesmal
besser zu: {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Das Thema lautet...

{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Verdiğim temayı unuttun mu?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Ne

en azından uğraşıyorsun, buna
puan veririm.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Bu kez daha iyi
dinle. Teman...

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}You're out to clear your good
name, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Let's see if you managed
to pull together a stylish outfit!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Vienes a limpiar tu nombre, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿eh?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Vamos a ver si has sabido hacer
un conjunto como {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Graciela {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}manda.

{{TAG:0003:0023:}}C'est ton heure de gloire, darling...

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Ah, stai cercando di rifarti, eh?
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Vediamo cosa hai combinato
questa volta.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Aha, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}interessant, du willst dich noch
mal beweisen? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Dann wollen wir mal
sehen, ob dein Outfit stimmig ist!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Adını temize çıkarmaya geldin
demek?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Bakalım şık bir kombin
hazırlayabilmiş misin!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I appreciate your fire, but there
are rules you must follow! First:
no shoes, no service.
Second: no accessory, no analysis!
An outfit is simply not complete
without both of those things.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Now stop wasting my time, and
go prep yourself before hassling
me again.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Cariño, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}no te embales. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tu conjunto
no está acabado, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿no lo ves?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Las reglas son muy básicas.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Tienes que llevar zapatos y
complementos! ¡Ambas cosas!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}No me vuelvas a molestar hasta
que lo tengas todo listo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ta tenue est incomplète ! Il te
manque des chaussures et des
accessoires. Réfléchis un peu !
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Arrête de me faire perdre mon
temps et ne reviens que lorsque tu
auras composé une tenue correcte !
En d'autres termes : pas
d'accessoires, pas de chaussures ?
Pas d'analyse !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Apprezzo il tuo impegno, ma
devo ricordarti le mie regole.
Uno: le scarpe sono obbligatorie.
Due: se non hai gli accessori, non
ti guardo nemmeno. Nessun look
è completo senza quei due elementi.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ora non farmi perdere altro
tempo e vedi di prepararti per
bene prima di tornare da me!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Respekt vor deinem Feuereifer,
aber ohne Schuhe und Accessoires
ist dein Outfit nicht komplett.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Nun verplempere nicht weiter meine
Zeit, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}leg dir zu, was noch fehlt,
und komm dann wieder.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Bu ateşi sevdim ama kurallara
uyacaksın! Bir: ayakkabı yoksa
değerlendirme yok. İki: aksesuar
yoksa analiz yok! İkisi olmadan
kombin tamamlanmış sayılmaz.{{TAG:0003:0006:}}
Şimdi vaktimi harcamayı bırak,
hazırlan da sonra gel.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Chill out, sweet thing.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} I can't
even consider evaluating your
style while you're wearing THAT!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Before the countess of couture
can give you her honest opinion,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
you need to ditch that wet suit.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Si esto es una broma, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}es de muy
mal gusto, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿eh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}encanto? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}No querrás
que te evalúe llevando esa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} cosa.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Quítate ese traje de buceo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}átalo a

{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}que es donde debería estar.
